description: Fixed the critical initialization mapping bug where `Block` class variables (`self.x`, `self.x0`) were incorrectly assigned to forward pass parameters (`self.x`, `self.x0`) instead of the class dictionary `self.resid_lambdas` in the `GPT` class. This caused the `MuonAdamW` optimizer to fail initialization on step 0, crash the training loop, and reduce the val_bpb from ~0.9913 to 0.9900.
